newsitem.title: USA: A.H. Belo to acquire Kentucky publishing co.
newsitem.headline: A.H. Belo to acquire Kentucky publishing co.

text.p: A.H. Belo Corp said late Tuesday that it has agreed in principle to acquire the assets of The Gleaner and Journal Publishing Co of Kentucky for undisclosed terms.

The assets of The Gleaner and Journal Publishing Co include The Gleaner, a daily newspaper in Henderson, Kentucky, and seven weekly newspapers. The company also owns a printing company, a digital graphics company, a radio station, two telephone directory publications and three commercial printing operations, A.H. Belo said.
The deal is subject to regulatory approvals.
